summary: Frontend-only testing of new session-based playback behavior. Removed schedule-based synchronization verified. All requested features working correctly: videos play from start, channel switching uses session elapsed time, playlist continues in background, unplayable videos auto-skipped and deleted.
passed_tests: Live TV page loads with channel list and video player (data-testid='live-tv-page')
Videos play from start (seekTime=0 for first video) - CONFIRMED via console: 'Playing: Video 99 at 0s'
Channel switching works - when switching back, playlist continues based on elapsed session time
Session-based playback: after 11s 'Playing: Video 31 at 11s', after 13s 'Playing: Video 99 at 13s'
Unplayable videos auto-skipped and deleted from database - YouTube error 150 triggers deletion
Up Next section shows upcoming videos from random playlist (3 items visible)
PLAYING indicator displayed instead of LIVE (no more time-of-day synchronization)
Video info display shows channel name, video title, duration
Duration updates sent to backend when videos play
Toast notification shows for deleted unavailable videos
critical_code_review_comments: getVideoFromPlaylist function correctly calculates video position based on elapsed seconds
sessionStartTime state properly initialized on mount and used throughout
selectChannel correctly passes sessionStartTime for elapsed time calculation
playNextVideo and skipToNextVideo handle video transitions properly
failedVideoIds Set prevents infinite loops with unplayable videos
context_for_next_testing_agent: Session-based playback fully verified. Key behavioral changes: 1) sessionStartTime set on component mount, 2) getVideoFromPlaylist calculates position using (now - sessionStartTime), 3) videos play to completion then advance via playNextVideo(), 4) channel switching preserves session time - playlist appears to continue in background. All features working as designed.
